title: Slack integration now supports threads
summary: If your team follows Frigade questions in Slack, a back and forth now reads as one conversation. Follow-up questions post as replies under the original message, the same way the conversation is alread
body_markdown:
[All updates](https://frigade.com/updates)


If your team follows Frigade questions in Slack, a back and forth now reads as one conversation. Follow-up questions post as replies under the original message, the same way the conversation is already grouped in the dashboard. That way, a channel that used to fill with loose notifications now holds one thread per conversation. This makes it a lot easier to track your Frigade Assistant's conversations with the same user.
